records.task: Follow the right common carotid exterior in the long-axis CT view. The worked case supplies its grayscale and duplex acquisition.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: The two contours at the inferior cutoff survive refinement. The worst whole-surface error is 1.39 mm and the protected frame-48 cut stays within 0.90 mm.
scoreEvidence.form: The curved right trunk has a continuous highlight in the reverse close-up. Its two small inferior projections are supported by the raw cut and the flat upper end marks the scan limit.
scoreEvidence.readability: The artery runs beside the jugular vein. At frame 48 the two dark bands in grayscale are easier to distinguish using the overlay and the oblique 3D course.
scoreEvidence.economy: The neck port falls from 2,340 to 1,650 triangles. Its worst turning-silhouette change is 0.50 px at 3 px/mm.

records.disposition: Adopt for the named 3D orientation task
records.note: The exterior supports side-specific course and orientation. Duplex signals, plaque, luminal patency and wall measurements require separate evidence.

records.task: Locate the right common carotid beside the thyroid in the transverse neck scene.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: The full traced course and its scan-limited superior rim pass the raw-label and protected-section checks on the s1127 grid.
scoreEvidence.form: The curved lower extent is preserved. The broad highlight follows the trunk in neutral clay and the reverse view.
scoreEvidence.readability: The vessel flanks the gland laterally. The axial orbit separates it from the thyroid and the trachea.
scoreEvidence.economy: The complete registered exterior uses 1,900 triangles and 34,232 bytes. Its 24 turning silhouettes stay within 1 px of the dense field.

records.disposition: Adopt for the named 3D context use
records.note: Both thyroid scenes render the full right common carotid port at frame 0. The neck crop has a separately reviewed export.
